candidates.content_text:
We’re on the lookout for a Civil Engineer to join our team based out of our head office in Henderson, Perth, Western Australia part of our mission to create smarter, more sustainable solutions for both our clients and the environment — particularly in the fields of Stormwater and Trade waste.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join the growing team at GRAF Australia. We are seeking a motivated, flexible and positive individual who is keen to learn. The role involves providing technical support to our distribution and sales teams located across Australia.
Your role will include:
- Supporting the technical department and assisting in designs and calculations
- Gain extensive knowledge of the product range and assist the sales team in providing engineered solutions.
- Producing AUTOCAD drawings and designs, updating and maintaining our drawing library to a high standard
- Developing and maintaining manuals
- Producing product proposals to gain approvals from different States and local councils
- Building rapport with internal and external stakeholders
- Working effectively within the team to meet the sales and operational needs
- Working alongside the quality team to develop and maintain production QC sheets and conduct production audits.
What you will bring:
- Excellent communication skills with confidence to present solutions and speak out
- A valid Class C driving license
- Civil Engineering Bachelor's qualification
- Preferred course topics related to fluid dynamics, environmental management, sustainable urban drainage design and flood management
- Core software skills, including AUTOCAD and REVIT
- SolidWorks is a nice-to-have skill
What we give in return:
- Birthday Leave – Enjoy a paid day off to celebrate your birthday.
- Employee Referral Program – Refer talented people to join our team and be rewarded for successful referrals.
- Novated Lease Options – Access flexible vehicle leasing arrangements through a novated lease.
- Wellness Incentive – Enjoy benefits and initiatives designed to support your health and wellbeing.
- Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – Access confidential support and professional assistance for you and your immediate family.
- Mentorship and training from experienced colleagues
- A role that offers future career progression

candidates.content_text:
The Opportunity:
Maitland City Council's Pathways program is a fantastic way to kick-start your career and gain professional experience in local government!
Commencing in January 2027, for a period of two years, we have two exciting opportunities for Graduate Civil Engineers to join our organisation.
In this role, you will undertake a graduate program developed specifically for you, giving you exposure to a range of civil engineering functions for the investigation and delivery of civil and recreation infrastructure projects undertaken by Council. These duties are going to help you develop a solid foundation to your civil engineering career.
About you:
To be successful in this role you will possess:
- Degree level qualifications in Civil engineering in the previous two years or completion of degree by January 2027
- Contemporary industry knowledge of civil engineering areas
- Experience and understanding in project support and the research, analysis and presentation of information
- Current Class C driver's licence
Benefits:
This Graduate position is temporary full time (two-year contract) with a commencing salary of $1,414.58 weekly, plus 12% superannuation. Graduates will also have access to Council's great staff benefits including:
- Flexible work arrangements
- One extra week of "My Leave" a year (to use how you like!)
- Ongoing training and development
- Fitness Passport
- Healthy Employee Program
To apply:
To apply for this opportunity, please click 'Apply Now' and submit your resume and cover letter.
Questions:
To viw the role charter click 'Apply Now'. If after reading the role charter you have any questions, please contact the recruitment team at Recruitment@maitland.nsw.gov.au
More information regarding Council's Pathways Program can be viewed via https://www.maitland.nsw.gov.au/pathways-program.
Applications close: Sunday 25th October 2027
Only candidates with current Australian work rights (Australian citizens, permanent residents, NZ citizens with a current passport, valid work visa) will be considered.
What happens next?
Once applications close, we will review all candidates' details against the role requirements and will be back in touch with you to advise the status of your application.
Please note, prior to an offer of employment being made, recommended candidates will be required to undertake a medical assessment (including drug and alcohol testing). Council also completes a range of other pre-employment checks which may include reference checks, psychometric testing or a criminal history check. For more information about the recruitment process, visit the "Jobs at Council" page on our website.
Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
Maitland City Council is dedicated to providing a workplace that is inclusive and supportive and is reflective of the diverse community we serve. We support equal opportunities for all employees, and encourage applications from people from all cultures, nationalities, identities, and abilities. We believe all employees have the right to feel valued, respected and heard. If you have any special considerations or accessibility requirements, please let us know in the recruitment process how we are able to meet your needs.
 If you require special assistance, or have any questions about the recruitment process please contact us for a confidential conversation (Recruitment@maitland.nsw.gov.au)

candidates.content_text:
Build Your Future Career with NEX Building Group
Arden Homes was established in 2010 and has built a reputation as being Victoria’s award-winning builder. Our homes have won some of the most prestigious awards from industry bodies and associations across Australia including the most demanding design categories. We create individual, innovative, and intelligent homes that stand out from the crowd and stand the test of time.
We are part of the NEX Building Group, an Australian network of more than 1300 passionate people who all share one purpose: to build beautiful homes for Australians
We are excited to offer Graduate opportunities within our 2027 Graduate Program, providing you with the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals, develop technical and leadership capabilities, and build a successful long-term career within our growing organisation. This opportunity is ideally suited to graduates with a passion for drafting and estimating.
About the Program
Commencing February 2027, our structured 2-year Graduate Program provides exposure to multiple areas of the residential building industry through a series of rotations. You’ll be based in the office Monday to Friday.
Throughout the program, graduates will participate in:
•Soft skills and professional development workshops
•Keynote speaker sessions with industry and business leaders
•A collaborative graduate group project
•Leadership development opportunities
•Tours of Supaloc, MyChoice, display homes and key supplier locations
•Dedicated mentor and buddy support
Following successful completion of the program, graduates will transition into a permanent role within NEX Building Group.
About You
We're looking for enthusiastic graduates who:
•Graduated in 2025 or 2026
•Hold a degree in Construction Management, Building and design, Built Environment, Property Development, Project Management, Trade Qualification or related discipline. 
•Have strong communication and relationship-building skills
•Demonstrate initiative, curiosity and a willingness to learn
•Are passionate about building a long-term career in the residential construction industry
•Are willing to undertake occasional interstate travel as part of the Graduate Program
Why Join NEX Building Group?
At NEX Building Group, our people are at the centre of everything we do. We foster a collaborative, inclusive and innovative culture where graduates are empowered to contribute from day one.
You'll benefit from:
•A structured career development pathway
•Exposure to multiple areas of the business
•Senior leader mentoring and support
•Strong networking opportunities across our brands
•Ongoing learning and development programs
•A clear transition into a permanent role at the completion of the program
•Employee benefits: Discounts on gym membership, motor vehicle, health insurance and MORE!
What You'll Need to Apply
We want your application journey to be as smooth as possible, so here's what you'll need to prepare:
•Your CV and Academic Transcripts
•A Cover Letter: Tell us about yourself, why are you interested, your career aspirations and where you'd like to grow within the business.
Interested?
The appointment of successful applicants will be subject to satisfactory employment screening and, depending on the inherent requirements of the role, may involve the completion of a National Police Check and pre-employment medical.
Applications are now open, with offers expected to be extended by the end of November 2026.
If you are determined to build a long-term career and want to join an innovative and inclusive organisation committed to building better lives, click Apply Now.
To find out more about NEX Building Group, visit www.nexbg.com.au, follow us on LinkedIn, or contact our Talent Acquisition Team at careers@nexbg.com.au.
If you're ready to build your future with one of Australia's leading residential building groups, apply now and join our 2027 Graduate Program.

candidates.content_text:
About the role 
We're looking for an experienced Survey Draftperson to join our QLD Drafting team, reporting to the Team Leader, Drafting Services. This is a hands-on support role for someone who already has a background in survey drafting and is ready to apply it across large-scale greenfields subdivision and infrastructure projects. We are seeking motivated candidates who are willing to relocate to Brisbane, QLD.
You'll turn field and design data into accurate, high-quality deliverables, including survey plans, lot calculations, topographic feature survey plans and Digital Terrain Models. You'll also interpret engineering design plans, prepare set-out calculations and field upload packages, and compare as-constructed data against design to pick up variances and quality issues before they reach the client. 
Previous experience in survey drafting is essential. You'll be working alongside some of the most experienced professionals in the industry, with plenty of opportunity to cross-train, share knowledge and keep building your skills. 
Who we are 
McMullen Nolan Group (MNG) was formed in 1989 to provide alternative survey services to the land development industry. Since then, we've been dedicated to delivering personalised, innovative spatial solutions to the Land Development and Engineering & Infrastructure sectors across Australia. Our core focus is survey services for large-scale greenfields subdivision clients, backed by award-winning laser scanning technology. Today, MNG is one of the pre-eminent survey businesses in Australia. 
Our values guide everything we do: Teamwork, Innovation and Knowledge. 
What we offer 
 - The opportunity to work alongside some of the most experienced and well-regarded professionals in the industry
 - Exciting and diverse projects across Queensland and New South Wales, including award-winning land developments and infrastructure projects
 - A supportive, people-focused team culture that promotes growth, learning, professional membership and work-life balance
 - Flexible working options and access to paid overtime
 - Cross-training and knowledge sharing with peers, so your skills keep growing 
What's involved in the role 
As a Survey Draftperson, you'll play a key support role in our QLD Drafting team, reporting to the Team Leader – Drafting Services. You will: 
 - Use AutoCAD, 12d and Civil 3D to create, amend and maintain survey plans, including lot calculations and topographic feature survey plans
 - Create and manage Digital Terrain Models (DTMs)
 - Interpret engineering design plans and incorporate design data into project deliverables
 - Prepare engineering base data for Disclosure Plans
 - Complete construction set-out calculations and prepare field upload packages
 - Compare as-constructed survey data against design documentation and identify variances
 - Validate survey data and flag discrepancies, errors or quality issues 
What you'll need 
 - Knowledge of AutoCAD, 12d, Civil 3D or a similar CAD program
 - Demonstrated knowledge of technical drawing or industrial graphics
 - Good mathematical ability
 - Strong attention to detail and good visual skills
 - Effective analytical and problem-solving skills
 - Good oral and written communication skills
 - The ability to work well as part of a team and meet delivery timeframes
 - A willingness and ability to learn to read and interpret engineering design plans and standard survey plans
 - Must have experience in Survey Drafting

candidates.content_text:
Survey Draftsperson – Gosford
de Witt Consulting is looking for a Survey Draftsperson to join our growing Gosford team.
This is an opportunity to work across a diverse range of surveying projects, collaborate closely with experienced surveyors and deliver drafting services within an established multidisciplinary consultancy.
As our Gosford office grows, there is scope for the role to develop into leading and coordinating additional drafting team members.
About the role
You will coordinate and deliver the Gosford office’s survey drafting requirements, working closely with our surveyors to prepare accurate, high-quality drawings.
Your work will include:
- Preparing set-out plans, deposited plans, detail plans and identification plans
- Supporting projects across construction, engineering, cadastral surveying, digital terrain modelling (DTM), laser scanning and drone surveys
- Liaising with surveyors to clarify project requirements and incorporate survey information
- Managing drafting priorities to meet project deadlines
- Checking drawings for accuracy, consistency and completeness
About you
We’re looking for someone who takes pride in their work, communicates well and enjoys contributing to a collaborative team.
You will bring:
- Experience using AutoCAD Civil 3D
- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate drawings
- Good organisation skills and the ability to manage competing priorities
- The ability to work independently and collaborate closely with our surveying team
- A proactive attitude and willingness to continue developing your skills
Knowledge of the surveying industry and experience preparing survey plans would be highly regarded.
About us
de Witt Consulting is a well-established and respected multidisciplinary consultancy providing Surveying, Town Planning, Ecology and Project Management services across NSW.
With offices in Newcastle, the Central Coast and the Mid-Western region, our team works across residential development, construction, infrastructure, renewables, mining and major civil projects.
We invest in our people and provide genuine opportunities to develop technically and progress their careers.
What we offer
- Exposure to a diverse range of surveying projects
- A supportive and experienced team
- Opportunities to develop your technical skills
- Scope to progress into a drafting team leadership role as the office grows
- An attractive employment package
- Flexible working arrangements for suitable applicants to support work–life balance
If you’re looking for an opportunity to contribute your drafting skills and grow your career on the Central Coast, we’d like to hear from you.
To join the de Witt Consulting team, submit your application via SEEK.

Civil Draftsperson (MicroStation & ProjectWise)
Join Hullcon
At Hullcon, we believe in Design with Delivery in Mind. Our work is practical, buildable and shaped by real delivery experience across transport infrastructure, renewables and civil engineering projects. We work closely with clients, contractors and delivery partners to develop solutions that perform both on paper and in the field.
We're looking for an experienced Civil Draftsperson who is highly proficient in Bentley MicroStation and ProjectWise and is excited about contributing to major infrastructure and renewable energy projects across Australia.
This is an office-based role in our Abbotsford office, designed to maximise collaboration with our engineers, designers and project managers.
The Role
You will be responsible for the preparation, management and coordination of high-quality engineering drawings and models for civil infrastructure projects. You will also be responsible for administering our ProjectWise system.
Working alongside experienced engineers and design managers, you'll play a key role in delivering documentation across a diverse portfolio that includes:
- Roads and highways
- Civil infrastructure
- Renewable energy projects
- Drainage and earthworks
- Buildings and associated civil works
- Temporary and permanent works
You will also have the opportunity to broaden your skillset into structural drafting and help drive the adoption of AI-enabled drafting workflows and automation tools.
What You'll Be Doing
- Producing civil and structural engineering drawings using Bentley MicroStation
- Managing project documentation and workflows in ProjectWise
- Coordinating drawing production across multidisciplinary teams
- Assisting with document control and drawing management
- Leading CAD standards, drafting efficiency and quality processes
- Exploring and implementing AI tools to improve drafting productivity, consistency and quality
- Structural drafting where required
About You
We're looking for someone who has:
Essential
- Strong experience using Bentley MicroStation and/or OpenRoads Designer
- Strong experience using and managing ProjectWise
- Experience drafting civil infrastructure projects in Victoria, particularly on major projects
- Excellent attention to detail and drawing presentation
- Strong understanding of engineering documentation standards
- Ability to work collaboratively within a project team
- Strong communication and organisational skills
Desirable
- Experience with OpenRoads Designer
- Experience with renewable energy projects
- Structural drafting experience
- Interest in automation, digital engineering and AI tools
- Experience working in ISO-aligned quality environments
- Experience in training and managing other drafters
Why Join Hullcon?
- Work directly with senior engineers and project leaders
- Exposure to major transport and renewable energy projects
- Genuine opportunity to shape how AI is used within engineering design
- Diverse project portfolio with technical challenges and variety
- Collaborative, office-based environment focused on mentoring and development
- Growing consultancy with significant opportunities for career progression
- Competitive salary package based on experience
Apply
If you're a skilled MicroStation Draftsperson looking to work on meaningful projects and are excited by the future of AI-enabled engineering design, we'd love to hear from you.
This is an office-based role with a minimum requirement of 3 days per week in the office.
Apply via SEEK with your CV and a brief cover letter outlining your Bentley MicroStation and ProjectWise experience. Only applicants with predominant Bentley experience will be considered.

candidates.content_text:
Graduate Engineering Officer (Ref: 1348)
About the position:
This position provides engineering support across the Infrastructure Services department with a focus on engineering investigations, roads in compliance with MRWA guidelines to regional road network and asset management, capital works, and asset creation proposals, including funding applications.  The role will also assist with civil design, drafting and estimating, and sustainability and environment initiatives.
Key accountabilities:
- Provide technical and engineering support to the Infrastructure Services department, under the general guidance of the Principal Engineer and Coordinator Design.
- Assist in the assessment of town planning and building applications (including structure plans, subdivisions, stormwater management plans and strategies, and road use assessments), preparing draft comments and conditions notes on behalf of Infrastructure Services Department to be reviewed by an Engineering Officer.
- Process development engineering applications (including crossover installations, bond administration and compliance matters) in accordance with the relevant legal provisions and the City’s Land Development Specifications, developing knowledge of the approvals process.
- Undertake site inspections and engineering investigations in response to requests, complaints and queries on Infrastructure Services related matters, and prepare accurate records, reports and recommendations.
For further information and to view the position description, visit www.cgg.wa.gov.au/employment/.
To gain a better understanding of the role or to discuss the position qualification requirements in detail, please call Chris Edwards, Manager Project Delivery and Engineering on (08) 9956 6949.
Position requirements:
The successful applicant will ideally hold a Degree in Civil Engineering or Design or progressing towards a Degree. Applicants with significant experience in the design and preparation of civil drawings in 12D and/or AutoCAD including project cost estimating will also be considered.
Completion of a pre-employment medical including alcohol and other substances testing is required of all positions at the City.
Remuneration and benefits:
This position offers a salary starting from $92,692 per annum, commensurate with the successful applicant’s knowledge, skills, experience and qualifications.
Some of the additional benefits of working for the City include:
- Up to 21% Superannuation (with superannuation co-contribution scheme)
- 22 Annual Leave days per annum
- Health & Wellbeing Program
- Flexible working arrangements
- Career opportunities
- Study Assistance
- Centrally located
- Free parking
About the City
Overlooking the Indian Ocean, Geraldton is a thriving regional city at the heart of Australia's Coral Coast. With a growing population of over 41,000 people it offers a wide range of services and activities. Geraldton is recognised as one of WA's key growth areas and the opportunities in this regional city are plentiful. You can be part of working with us to deliver the best for our community and this region.
The City of Greater Geraldton actively welcomes, includes and values the unique contributions of all people in its workplace. The City welcomes applications from all age groups, people with a disability, and those from diverse ethnic and cultural backgrounds. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer with strong commitment to fitness for work and safety in the workplace.
Interested in applying?
Visit the City’s website: www.cgg.wa.gov.au/employment/ to apply for this position.
To be considered for this vacancy, applicants are advised to include the following:
- A current resume
- A written response (maximum 1250 characters per criteria) addressing the following selection criteria inclusive of examples to support your claims:
i. Experience in investigations and the preparation of engineering planning reports
ii. Sound understanding of civil engineering principles and practices, with a developing knowledge of development engineering, subdivision and infrastructure assets
iii. Developing knowledge and appreciation of relevant legislation, regulations, Australian Standards, Austroads and Main Roads WA guidelines, and current development engineering requirements within Western Australia (including IPWEA subdivision guidelines)
iv. Sound written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear reports and correspondence and to liaise with interna and external stakeholders
v. Excellent time management skills with ability to organise workloads, meet deadlines and maintain high levels
vi. Ability to use relevant engineering, drafting, MS Office applications and spatial software or a demonstrated aptitude to learn
Applications close 4pm Thursday 15 October 2026.
Ross McKim
CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER

candidates.content_text:
D&J’s Civil Construction is a respected and growing civil construction company delivering high-quality civil infrastructure and subdivision projects across South East Queensland.
With a strong pipeline of work, we are looking for a Graduate Civil Engineer to join our team and develop their career alongside experienced engineers, supervisors and construction crews.
This is a great opportunity for a graduate who wants to get out on site, get hands-on experience and learn how civil construction actually works from the ground up.
The Role
Working closely with our Project Managers, Site Engineers and Supervisors, you will gain exposure to a variety of civil construction projects, including subdivisions, earthworks, stormwater, sewer, watermain and pipe installation works.
Your responsibilities will grow as your experience develops and may include:
- Assisting with day-to-day site management and coordination
- Reading and interpreting construction drawings and specifications
- Assisting with set-out, levels and grade checking
- Preparing and maintaining QA documentation, ITPs and checklists
- Completing daily diaries and site records
- Assisting with quantities, take-offs and material requirements
- Monitoring subcontractors, deliveries and site activities
- Assisting with project cost tracking and variations
- Liaising with supervisors, subcontractors, suppliers and clients
- Assisting with progress claims and project documentation
- Participating in toolbox meetings and site inspections
- Ensuring works are completed safely and in accordance with project requirements
- Learning the practical side of civil construction and developing into a confident Site Engineer
What We're Looking For
We are looking for someone who is keen to learn, reliable and ready to get stuck into the work.
You will ideally have:
- A Bachelor of Civil Engineering or be nearing completion
- Previous civil construction experience is advantageous
- A current Australian driver's licence
- White Card
- Good communication and organisational skills
- The ability to work as part of a team
- A practical, hands-on attitude
- Strong attention to detail
- A willingness to learn and take direction
- The ability to work in a fast-paced construction environment
Most importantly, we're looking for someone with the right attitude who wants to build a long-term career in civil construction.
Location: South East Queensland – work may be across Brisbane, Ipswich, Gold Coast and surrounding areas.
If you're a recent Civil Engineering graduate who wants to learn, get out on site and build a career in the civil construction industry, we'd love to hear from you.

Ready to get your hands dirty and start building your future?
Apply now to begin your civil construction career with DLS Group Civils and Programmed Apprenticeships & Traineeships, while earning a wage and gaining a nationally recognised qualification.

About the role 
We're looking for an experienced Survey Draftperson to join our QLD Drafting team, reporting to the Team Leader, Drafting Services. This is a hands-on support role for someone who already has a background in survey drafting and is ready to apply it across large-scale greenfields subdivision and infrastructure projects. 
You'll turn field and design data into accurate, high-quality deliverables, including survey plans, lot calculations, topographic feature survey plans and Digital Terrain Models. You'll also interpret engineering design plans, prepare set-out calculations and field upload packages, and compare as-constructed data against design to pick up variances and quality issues before they reach the client. 
Previous experience in survey drafting is essential. You'll be working alongside some of the most experienced professionals in the industry, with plenty of opportunity to cross-train, share knowledge and keep building your skills. 
Who we are 
McMullen Nolan Group (MNG) was formed in 1989 to provide alternative survey services to the land development industry. Since then, we've been dedicated to delivering personalised, innovative spatial solutions to the Land Development and Engineering & Infrastructure sectors across Australia. Our core focus is survey services for large-scale greenfields subdivision clients, backed by award-winning laser scanning technology. Today, MNG is one of the pre-eminent survey businesses in Australia. 
Our values guide everything we do: Teamwork, Innovation and Knowledge. 
What we offer 
 - The opportunity to work alongside some of the most experienced and well-regarded professionals in the industry
 - Exciting and diverse projects across Queensland and New South Wales, including award-winning land developments and infrastructure projects
 - A supportive, people-focused team culture that promotes growth, learning, professional membership and work-life balance
 - Flexible working options and access to paid overtime
 - Cross-training and knowledge sharing with peers, so your skills keep growing 
What's involved in the role 
As a Survey Draftperson, you'll play a key support role in our QLD Drafting team, reporting to the Team Leader – Drafting Services. You will: 
 - Use AutoCAD, 12d and Civil 3D to create, amend and maintain survey plans, including lot calculations and topographic feature survey plans
 - Create and manage Digital Terrain Models (DTMs)
 - Interpret engineering design plans and incorporate design data into project deliverables
 - Prepare engineering base data for Disclosure Plans
 - Complete construction set-out calculations and prepare field upload packages
 - Compare as-constructed survey data against design documentation and identify variances
 - Validate survey data and flag discrepancies, errors or quality issues 
What you'll need 
 - Knowledge of AutoCAD, 12d, Civil 3D or a similar CAD program
 - Demonstrated knowledge of technical drawing or industrial graphics
 - Good mathematical ability
 - Strong attention to detail and good visual skills
 - Effective analytical and problem-solving skills
 - Good oral and written communication skills
 - The ability to work well as part of a team and meet delivery timeframes
 - A willingness and ability to learn to read and interpret engineering design plans and standard survey plans
 - Must have experience in Survey Drafting
